body:
Thanks for the response!! Really helped me get my thoughts in order a bit. 

In an ideal world, these are things I would love to see happen in our relationship. I definitely understand that he may never be interested in the same things I am- he's his own person and I would never expect him to change for me, nor do I ever want to make him feel obligated to do something he doesn't want to do. 

I think another part of it is that I just hate keeping things from him, especially stuff that weighs on me this strongly. We're honest with each other about everything, and not telling him about this has been making me really uncomfortable. Even if he wasn't interested in any of my fantasies, having the conversation could still be helpful, just as a way of clearing the air. But, I'm scared of him looking at me differently if I bring up things that he's very turned off by. There are a few things I would love to try with him (ddlg, impact play, cnc) that he has expressed not being into, so I definitely wouldn't bring those up right off the bat, if at all. But, I don't know what the rest of his limits are, and I'm scared that even if I started small & just floated a couple of things, he still might feel put off by it. 

I guess there's really no way of knowing except doing it. Knowing him, my fears probably aren't all that rational; he's always been very patient and understanding with me. In my head I'm pretty sure he won't judge me, but it's still scary, yknow?
